verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated Browser feature that opens websites, gathers current information and takes action under user control. They say it can compare options and complete multi-step tasks on websites, and that it works with signed-in tabs across Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. Supporting docs cover site actions via WebMCP, sign-in flows, admin controls over browser use, and Computer Use for operating GUIs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of browser agent task completion (the community items about browsing concern search and plugins, not agentic operation).
